title: Crisis engulfs Labour as deputy PM Angela Rayner is forced to step down
summary: Starmer brings forward cabinet reshuffle to restore order but fallout likely to further damage party’s reputation Keir Starmer is battling to get a grip on the crisis that has engulfed his government, with his deputy prime minister Angela Rayner forced to step down after breaching the ministerial code over her tax arrangements. The prime minister brought forward a major cabinet reshuffle in an attempt to restore order and get back on the front foot after a damaging few days, with Yvette Cooper, David Lammy and Shabana Mahmood all moved to prominent new roles.
